spec_match.rationale: Connects the W3C WebTransport.prototype.draining Promise and HTTP/3 DRAIN_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION (0x78ae) capsule to real-world server rollout and Kubernetes/Envoy termination grace period sizing.

interactive.rationale: Interactive sliders for active sessions, p50/p99 stream duration, and server drain deadline plus workload profile presets dynamically update survival metrics and the SVG decay curve.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index blurb promising a p50/p95/p99 stream duration vs server drain deadline calculator.

edge_cases.rationale: Models long-tail streaming LLM pipelines where a 12s drain deadline truncates p99 streams (18s) versus low-latency RPC workloads that drain within 4s.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified slider adjustments, profile presets, SVG path updates, and responsive behavior on desktop and 360px mobile viewports.

telemetry_health.rationale: Reports showcaseTelemetry.assert('drain-budget-computed') on load and slider changes with zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Uses CSS variables from /public/styles.css and named SVG stroke colors (black, royalblue, crimson) with zero hex/rgba/hsla literals.

accessibility.rationale: All sliders have explicit <label> associations and 44px minimum height, the SVG has role='img', aria-label, and <title>, and <output> uses aria-live='polite'.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Uses responsive auto-fit grid layouts and a viewBox-scaled SVG chart so 360px mobile viewports render cleanly without horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: defer rendering heavy content below the fold
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size on below-the-fold sections.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .deferred-section to the code path and see-also sections.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible range sliders and preset buttons
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair range inputs with explicit labels that display live values and keep minimum 44px tap targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Paired all 4 range sliders with <label> elements showing live millisecond/second readouts and enforced min-height: 44px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible inline SVG charts and live regions
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give informative SVGs role='img', aria-label, and <title>, and mirror chart conclusions in an aria-live='polite' output.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added role='img', aria-label, and <title> to #drain-chart and echoed the computed survival ratio in #budget-output.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive SVG chart and metric grid on narrow mobile viewports
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use width: 100%; height: auto with viewBox on SVGs and auto-fit minmax grid tracks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Configured #drain-chart with viewBox='0 0 600 180' and width: 100% inside a responsive CSS grid.

summary: Interactive server rollout and load-balancer drain timeout budget calculator for WebTransport.prototype.draining.
